description: On the yellow tabletop in front of the person, there’s an open white AirPods charging case, two earbuds lying nearby, and a red cloth backdrop behind them. The right hand moves in from the right to pick up the charging case and bring it toward the center while the left hand comes in to steady it, then the right hand lifts one earbud and inserts it into the open case, reaches to grab the second earbud, and places it into the case as well before the hands close and set the case down.
